run_ui_md_lines: Develop > Spot removal (top of the Develop panel): pick Spot mode heal / clone / distraction, then click the preview to place a spot (radius 0.05 of the shorter side), or drag from an empty point to set the radius.

Drag a spot's yellow source circle, or Alt+drag from inside a spot, to move its source. Each spot row has a type switch (heal <-> clone) and Remove; distraction spots have Remove. Every change is one EDIT > Undo step.

Sliders develop.spot.<i>.centre_x/centre_y/radius/feather/opacity/source_x/source_y and develop.distraction.<i>.radius sit in the Spot removal section; state_json develop.spots, develop.distraction, develop.retouch_enables and develop.spot_preview (rect, frame, mode) show the state.
